home.subtitle: Gabriel Hernández
home.description: Specialized in creating innovative and scalable web solutions, combining modern design with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional user experiences.
home.aboutDescription: I’m a frontend developer passionate about turning complex ideas into engaging and functional digital experiences. With over two years of professional experience, I’ve collaborated with teams on innovative projects, such as an interactive math book, and contributed to the development of dynamic web applications using React, Node.js, and other modern technologies. My approach blends creativity, technical precision, and a mathematical touch to design interfaces that not only stand out visually but also provide practical solutions to real-world problems.

guitars-la.name: GuitarLA
guitars-la.description: A fully functional e-commerce platform built with Next.js, featuring advanced pagination, seamless PostgreSQL integration, and a dynamic shopping cart system for an enhanced user experience.

product-hunt.name: Product Hunt Clone
product-hunt.description: A real-time Product Hunt replica using Firebase for authentication and data storage, Next.js for server-side rendering, and Styled Components for a modern, sleek interface.

mern-uptask.name: MERN-Uptask
mern-uptask.description: A real-time task management application leveraging the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Socket.io for instant updates and collaborative features.

veterinary-control.name: Veterinary Control
veterinary-control.description: A comprehensive veterinary appointment management system built with React and TailwindCSS, designed to streamline clinic operations and improve scheduling efficiency.

create-interactive.name: Create Interactive
create-interactive.description: An offline-first CRUD application using IndexedDB for robust local storage, ensuring a seamless and uninterrupted user experience even without an internet connection.

expense-manager.name: Expense Manager
expense-manager.description: A personal finance tracking tool built with React and localStorage, enabling users to manage budgets effectively with persistent storage and intuitive controls.

drink-finder.name: Drink Finder
drink-finder.description: A cocktail discovery app integrated with an external API, utilizing React Context for efficient state management and a responsive design powered by Bootstrap.

weather-app.name: Weather App
weather-app.description: A real-time weather dashboard developed with React Context and TailwindCSS, delivering accurate global forecasts in a clean, user-friendly interface.

car-insurance.name: Car Insurance Calculator
car-insurance.description: A dynamic car insurance premium calculator built with React Context and TailwindCSS, offering real-time analysis of various factors for precise insurance estimates.

news-finder.name: News Finder
news-finder.description: A multi-category news aggregator using React Context for state management and Material-UI for a modern, responsive, and visually appealing interface.

instant-cryptos.name: Instant Cryptos
instant-cryptos.description: A real-time cryptocurrency tracking platform with an integrated currency converter and advanced market analysis tools, designed for both casual users and serious investors.

vaccine-manager.name: Cattle Vaccine Manager
vaccine-manager.description: A comprehensive application for managing cattle vaccinations, built with React, Express, and MongoDB. It allows user registration, detailed vaccine information management, the creation of transporter guides, and the generation of vaccinated cattle declarations, all downloadable in PDF format. Leveraging React Router for smooth and efficient navigation, it provides a robust and user-friendly solution for tracking and controlling the vaccination process.
